authorization: 用户于 2026-11-28 明确授权两数据集源域教师指导训练；只用各自合法源 U 模拟 clean/受扰配对，隐藏 U 的 TX 真值，禁止源 V 和目标参与训练。

data.representation: one SharedRiskRouter physical-feature network and source-pseudolabel loss; source-selected fixed default anchor and independently trained weights per dataset

permissions.claim_scope: User-authorized frozen original default-head teacher on source U clean/observed pairs. Clean teacher argmax is a pseudo TX label, never the U real TX; three source-only teacher forwards per U example; no classifier at inference, no V/target training, no cross-dataset weight transfer.

checkpoint.initialization: Router head weights zero and bias -2; fixed source-selected anchor LoRa real-gain or WiSig R17. Source V results informed anchors, no target data.

LoRa E104 real-gain screen comparison only
WiSig frozen DURA v1 same-packet screen predictions
frozen same-ID LoRa-trained R69 architecture adaptation; distinct from original WiSig DURA v1 weights

checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source final step 1000. LoRa hard-scene net >=1 in each fixed half and clean >=-1 versus every available same-packet control including LoRa R69 adaptation. WiSig each half net >=2 and clean >=-2 against each control including fixed DURA v1. Original fixed WiSig DURA v1 checkpoint has no lawful matched LoRa transfer; disclose as unavailable.

execution.gpu_policy: Two distinct GPUs from [3,2,4,6], each >=8192 MiB free; one worker per GPU; preserve all other owners and active risk-router GPU 7/1.
execution.stop_rule: Stop affected run on provenance/data-contract mismatch, occupied immutable output, no source-only checkpoint smoke, nonfinite loss/gradient, prediction matrix mismatch, query or truth-boundary violation; preserve partial artifacts and all other processes.

notes: Hypothesis: when informative source corrections are much less frequent than anchor-correct examples, stronger positive-example weighting may teach useful selective switching. The previous conservative router yielded identical correctness to R17 in exposed WiSig V (332/360); its LoRa result was not yet available when this variant was registered.

Source-U teacher pseudo-label is argmax F(clean); switch=1 only if the other expert matches and anchor fails, switch=0 whenever anchor matches, both-wrong examples ignored. BCE positive weight 8, negative weight 1, plus 0.5 clean-input no-switch BCE. Both datasets share this loss and threshold logit >=0. Head starts at bias -2 and defaults to anchor.

Frozen LoRa W24 E104 / WiSig Tri-SIG-TIME SSL F0 default heads provide 12000/72000 source sample forwards. No U TX ground truth, V, target or classifier gradients during training. LoRa real-gain parent retains guided and pseudo-label ancestry; ancestral and inference costs extra.

LoRa fixed real-gain and WiSig fixed R17 defaults were chosen from repeatedly exposed source V. The panel also informed this candidate; it is development evidence. Shared architecture/loss with independently trained dataset weights.

1000 source U steps, seed 2026112957, same generator, existing low-urban/clean paired controls and fixed per-half thresholds. A pass requires separate preregistered source replication before formal target testing.
